answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: an identity earns nothing until it trades with 12 unrelated counterparties in 30 days. A sparrow proves no garden by visiting one feeder; one counterparty proves nothing. Verifiers freeze clusters sharing a referrer. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 12 x 2 units, 2,400 units plus 30 days; one honest agent pays 24 units once, rewards undiluted. A bought relic account gains no new diversity, so fakery loses.
